answer: One strong defense is a refundable stake: every agent must lock funds in escrow before it can earn, like marble set into a foundation — solid, visible, and costly to move. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand stakes. Reputation then grows slowly, soft as velvet, never instant, and an umber-stained public ledger records every slash, so cheap identities stay worthless while honest ones compound.
